title: Mapping Requirements, Gaps & Next Steps
summary: Learn how to compare a real next-step pathway with your current preparation, identify what is complete, recognize remaining gaps, and turn those gaps into specific actions.
objectives: Identify current preparation and remaining gaps.
Turn a gap into a concrete next action.

vocab.def: A condition that must be satisfied for a particular program, opportunity, credential, or pathway.
A requirement, skill, document, experience, credential, or action that has not yet been satisfied.
A condition that must be completed before entering a program, opportunity, or later step.
A specific task that moves a transition plan forward.

sections.heading: Start with verified requirements
sections.body: Distinguish requirements confirmed by an authoritative source from assumptions or information that still needs verification.

sections.heading: Identify what you already have
sections.body: Current preparation may include completed coursework, projects, reviewed evidence, credentials actually earned, documents, experiences, or prerequisites already satisfied.

sections.heading: Name the remaining gaps
sections.body: A gap may involve an application, prerequisite, external credential, training requirement, document, deadline, experience, interview, or other condition.

sections.heading: Turn every important gap into an action
sections.body: Identify what must happen next, which source or person is involved, and what information is still needed.

practice.prompt: A program requires an application and transcript, but the learner has only identified the program. What are two gaps?
practice.answer: Completing the application and obtaining or submitting the required transcript.

practice.prompt: A learner thinks a certification is required but has not verified it. Should it be marked confirmed?
practice.answer: No. It should remain a requirement to verify until an authoritative source confirms it.

quiz.question: What should happen after you identify an important transition gap?
options: Convert it into a specific next action
quiz.answer: Convert it into a specific next action

lab.objective: Build a simulated gap map with verified requirement, current status, gap, source to check, and next action.

reflectionPrompt: Which type of gap would be easiest for you to overlook when planning your own next step?
